base_game_loop.summary: Knight Fight: paid spin on 6x6 (expands to 8 rows). The number of possible paylines vary based on the position of the knights.. Avalanche/tumble after wins. Bonus modes: Super Bonus. Round ends on win cap if reached.

phases.name: Place bet and spin
phases.what_happens: Player selects bet and hits Spin (or Auto Spin). Optional: activate an X-iter mode from base game only before the drop/spin.
phases.state_changes: Bet locked; optional X-iter mode selected

phases.name: Initial symbol drop/spin
phases.what_happens: Symbols land on 6x6 (expands to 8 rows). Game-specific setup features may fire (birds, Nitro/COOL reels, collectors, etc.).
phases.ends_when: All symbols at resting positions / reels stopped

phases.name: Evaluate wins
phases.what_happens: Evaluate wins: The number of possible paylines vary based on the position of the knights.

phases.name: Remove winners and Avalanche
phases.what_happens: Winning symbols explode/are removed; remaining symbols fall; new symbols drop in. Continues while new wins appear.
phases.ends_when: No new winning combinations after a fill
phases.state_changes: Grid updated; avalanche chain may continue

phases.name: End-of-drop features
phases.what_happens: Resolve end-of-round features (bombs, mystery reveals, row swaps, boosters, etc.) if nothing else can happen; may resume avalanches.

phases.name: Bonus trigger check
phases.what_happens: If bonus/super-bonus trigger conditions met, enter bonus mode after resolving same-drop features. Otherwise settle base-game wins subject to win cap.
phases.state_changes: Enter bonus mode or settle base round

is a 6 row by 6 column slot that can expand up to 8 rows by 8 columns. Central game features are: The four knights that move around the grid collecting crest symbols and feature symbols, the symbol collection meter that counts the number of symbols collected and adds a pending feature symbol release when the meter is full, and finally the bonus game with free drops.
Wins are generated by the four knights collecting horizontally or vertically adjacent crest symbols, resulting in a varying number of ways to win.

X-iter rules
The X-iter feature offers several different game modes.
SUPER BONUS: 
Guarantees a game round with entry to the super bonus game. All free drops are played with the maximum grid size, and all upgrade symbols upgrade all crest symbols at the cost of __X05_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
BONUS: 
Guarantees a game round with entry to the bonus game at the cost of __X04_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
MAXIMUM GRID SIZE: 
One drop that is played with the maximum grid size at the cost of __X03_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
GOLDEN APPLE FEAST: 
One drop with the Golden Golden Apple Basket feature activated from start at the cost of __X02_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
BONUS HUNT:
